newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher after spot expiry.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher after spot expiry.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed higher on Friday, as buying orders from local investors emerged after the expiry of spot July, traders said.
Benchmark December was up 0.6 yen at 119.1 yen per kg. The spot July contract expired at midday at 91.1 yen, down 2.8 yen from Thursday's close, with 442 lots of deliveries.
Traders said that long liquidation in spot July ahead of its expiry had been weighing down the market in the past weeks.
"With a bearish factor now gone, I expect prices to recover next week," a rubber analyst at a commodity brokerage house in Tokyo said. - Tokyo Commodities Desk (+81-3-3432-7391)
